newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla cattle steady in moderate trade -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla cattle steady in moderate trade -USDA.

text.p: Trade moderate in the panhandle area Thursday. Slaughter steers and heifers steady.
Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 6,800 slaughter steers and 1,000 heifers; 135,700 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 21,900 formulated and 4,900 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 64.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 63.00.
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 64.00.
Week to date 135,700 Week Ago 82,500 Year Ago 74,700.
